summary: 合同收费模板/生效条款只读快照与结算核对首片 on BASE 6ddb951. Added pmo_plugins/contracts/terms_snapshot_services.py with two read-only interfaces. approved_terms_snapshot(member, *, contract_id, as_of=None) returns the contract ref/status/termination marker, the approved-or-historical version ref selected by as_of (approved version effective on/before as_of, latest approved fallback), its effective date, pricing template codes, up to 200 contract lines with template/amounts/active payment+warranty term breakdown and terms total, a change-history summary (change ref/type/status/requested_on, recorded effective_on, before/after version refs), and PM summary_only/settlement_guard flags; each line prefers the existing approval_services.approved_terms_snapshot named read and falls back to a read-only historical projection (readable=false with a reason) when termination/history/amount guards reject. terms_settlement_issues(member, *, as_of=None) returns read-only reconciliation anomalies with issue_code/contract_ref/refs/expected/actual: terms_amount_mismatch (active term total != line gross), settlement_partition_mismatch (active settlement gross != open-item partition total), settlement_terms_mismatch (frozen selected terms total != settlement gross), terms_unapproved_referenced, stale_version_referenced (settlement references a superseded version), line_repeated_consumption (multiple active settlements on one line), cross_project_reference, cross_org_reference, terminated_still_settled (active settlement on/after termination date), and old_terms_still_active (superseded-version lines still have active terms). Permissions are owner/finance/auditor full, PM only managed projects with summary_only=true, member denied, cross-tenant/unknown denied; the new history_read route contract-terms-snapshot keeps the historical page readable after the contracts module is disabled, rejects unknown query parameters and has no POST/write entry. No model, migration, canonical topic/command/schema, contracts/settlement write path or business fact changed; no audit/receipt/event side effect is written (the optional generic viewed audit was deliberately skipped to keep reads pure). Amounts stay integer cents; template codes follow the PH-214 delivery (fixed_milestone/confirmed_time/fixed_service_period) rather than the legacy wording in the spec.
